new_defects.evidence: internal/mcp/server.go:618-624 limits admission using inflight; lines 627-634 release that admission before handleLine calls writeAsync at lines 375-376. writeAsync has no queue deadline at line 726.
new_defects.description: A stalled client can keep submitting successful tools/call requests. Completed calls leave inflight before waiting for output-queue room, so blocked response workers no longer count toward MaxPending or MaxPendingBytes. An asynchronous-only request stream never invokes the reader's queue deadline and can accumulate unbounded goroutines and response buffers, eventually exhausting memory. This finding is from source inspection; no new probe was written.
new_defects.fix: Keep each call's admission reservation until its response is enqueued or abandoned. Once pending output exhausts admission capacity, reject further calls through the bounded reader response path, or apply an equivalent bounded output budget and saturation timeout.
